about: big emote-only lines: when a line is only pictures it is drawn larger. one file for every app.
read: the law's read of the line, one entry per word in order. emote = a picture the law drew (room, user, global or platform-native);
emoji = one unicode emoji (a word of three is three); overlay = a zero-width emote or a name0 stacked on the picture before it;
mod = a modifier word bound to a picture; text = anything else (a word, a link, a mention, punctuation, a name the room does not know,
a taken-down emote, a modifier with nothing to change). line is the text the read came from, there for the reader: the runner uses read.
pictures counts emote and emoji, never an overlay or a modifier (an overlay with no picture before it draws inline and counts).
want is big for 1 to rules.max pictures and no text; anything else is normal. rules.scale is how many times the line's normal emote
height a big picture is drawn. a runner that meets a kind or a field it does not know must fail, never skip.
